role: Explanatory infographic, not experiment imagery or trained-model outputs
base_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational infographic. Create a clear, professional landscape explanatory image for an ML researcher. Title EXACT: 'What was actually tested'. Subtitle EXACT: 'Preflight checks — no full denoiser training'. Three spacious numbered panels left to right with a consistent white background, restrained colors, large legible text, simple arrows and illustrative grayscale image thumbnails. This is an explanatory illustration, not a fabricated research plot. Panel 1 heading '1. Random subtraction'. Show a simple step-edge image plus Gaussian speckles becoming a noisy image; subtract a DIFFERENT independent Gaussian noise sample to produce a more speckled candidate. Label the sample source 'Oracle Gaussian sampler'. Add exact measured badges 'Noisy input MSE: 0.0100', 'After subtraction: 0.0200', 'Average 64 candidates: 0.0102'. Takeaway EXACT: 'Matching the noise law does not reveal its realization'. Panel 2 heading '2. MUSIQ on toy images'. Show flat gray and checker-block thumbnails, each clean beside a noisy version. A compact exact score table with headings 'Clean' and 'Noisy (σ = 0.05)': row 'Gray' values '17.65' and '33.62'; row 'Blocks' values '37.77' and '42.60'. Add 'MUSIQ: higher is better'. Takeaway EXACT: 'Noisy toy images received higher scores'. Panel 3 heading '3. Prototype wiring'. Show two distinct small branches: 'Masked noisy image' to 'CNN encoder + decoder' to 'Pixel prediction'; separately 'Uniform samples' to 'Shared spline KAN' to 'Noise samples'. Do not connect these branches into a trained denoising loop. Underneath list checks with checkmark symbols: 'Forward pass', 'Gradients + update', 'Hidden-pixel exclusion', 'Checkpoint save / restore'. Takeaway EXACT: 'Wiring verified; hybrid not trained'. Footer EXACT: 'Illustrative thumbnails. Numbers come from the saved preflight tests.' Avoid extra claims, fabricated curves, dense paragraphs, decorative robots, logos or watermarks. Preserve all numerical values and separate actual completed checks from a future architecture.
final_edit_prompt: Edit the supplied infographic with a precise scientific-label correction. Preserve the overall layout, all three panels, all scores, all numerical MSE values, illustrations, typography, title and footer. In the LEFT PANEL ONLY, change BOTH Gaussian noise sigma labels from '(σ = 0.05)' to '(σ = 0.10)'. The subtraction control used sigma 0.1 and MSE 0.0100, so this is essential. Keep every sigma = 0.05 label in the MIDDLE MUSIQ PANEL unchanged because those separate score examples used sigma 0.05. Also make the LEFT PANEL subtraction flow unambiguous: the operation is 'Noisy input − independent Gaussian noise = candidate'. A concise arrow or text label can clarify this without changing its data badges. Do not imply that the right-panel pixel prediction is a validated trained reconstruction; retain 'Wiring verified; hybrid not trained'. Do not change any measured numbers. No other changes.
quality_check: Both left-panel sigma labels corrected to 0.10; middle-panel 0.05 labels and measured numbers preserved.
